_comment: Seed expected-findings benchmark for lab APKs. must_have = high-signal rules that should appear; must_not = known false-positive classes after precision filters; notes = coverage caveats.

AndroGoat.notes: OkHttp/Conscrypt HostnameVerifier type refs and bare checkServerTrusted must not fire. Xposed must not match ExposedDropdownMenu. WebView challenges may still FN if strings differ from addJavascriptInterface.
